gloss: out of the question; beyond consideration

definitions.gloss: out of the question; beyond consideration
definitions.explanation: Something so unacceptable or unreasonable that it is not even worth discussing. Often used to flatly reject a proposal or to condemn behavior as inexcusable.

examples.japanese: そんな{提案|ていあん}は{問題外|もんだいがい}だ。
examples.english: A proposal like that is out of the question.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}して{謝|あやま}らないなんて{問題外|もんだいがい}だ。
examples.english: Showing up late and not apologizing is beyond consideration.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{倍|ばい}にするという{案|あん}は、{今|いま}の{会社|かいしゃ}には{問題外|もんだいがい}だ。
examples.english: The idea of doubling the budget is out of the question for the company right now.

notes:
Used to dismiss something as not even worth considering. Almost always appears as {問題外|もんだいがい}だ or {問題外|もんだいがい}の〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {問題外|もんだいがい}だ: to be out of the question
- まったく{問題外|もんだいがい}: completely out of the question

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論外|ろんがい}: out of the question — very close in meaning, slightly more formal
- ありえない: unthinkable; impossible — more colloquial
